reasoning: The agent clearly clears the level-5 bar (backing out a wrong assumption per crate) and shows a distinct level-8 instance: recognizing the object-safety problem and propagating the corrected generic-trait contract from storage to its memory/etcd backends and onward to controllers, plus re-deriving the etcd API from the reference after a falsified assumption. It falls short of a clean 8/10 because much of the long error-fixing horizon is incremental symptom patching and there is notable tooling churn (configmap) rather than consistent foundational re-derivation, placing observed behavior at 7.
